name: Great-West Lifeco Inc. Preferred Shares (GWO.PR.M)
summary: Great-West Lifeco Inc. is a financial services company operating in Canada, the United States and Europe, specialising in asset management, reinsurance, retirement and investment solutions and insurance for life and health. Its insurance range includes dental, health, creditor, life, accidental death, disability and critical illness cover, and it also offers retirement savings, wealth and annuity products.
